fact: The Monitor reports that NITA-U and Tanzania Telecommunications Corporation (TTCL) signed a memorandum of understanding on 29 September 2023, under which Tanzania would connect Uganda's National ICT Broadband Backbone to its regional fibre loop.
system: NITA-U and TTCL fibre interconnection MoU

fact: Uganda's Northern Corridor projects head says Uganda and Rwanda made the final fibre connection at Mirama Hills earlier in 2026, built under the Northern Corridor Integration Projects; operators must still agree capacity before it is switched on.
PML Daily reports Uganda and Kenya have completed a fibre connection at Busia, with an agreement between NITA-U and Kenya's ICT Authority still to be finalised before commercial service.

Uganda's Ministry of ICT says it signed a memorandum of understanding on 11 May 2026 with the DRC Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, including a project to connect Uganda's National Backbone Infrastructure to the DRC's fibre-optic network.
system: Uganda National Backbone to DRC fibre interconnection
